gen-dafont-nordic-gf-domine: Domine reads with a dignified, compact look, its curves holding a little breathing space inside each glyph. Nordic is the opposite: closed, single-weight and ancient, with no hairlines to lose.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-halant: Authoritative and traditional, Halant has a soft swing from thick to thin. Nordic, by contrast, is ancient and closed, drawn like wire with one thickness throughout.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Hedvig Letters Serif has open-ended curves and sturdy, upright lowercase with modest thick-thin contrast. Nordic hunches over it, closed and smooth as a pen-plotter line, with brush-dab spacing; Hedvig Letters Serif gives the page its room.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-domine: Domine brings compact ascenders and a refined, dignified voice. Beneath Nulshock's cable-like outlines, with no swelling or thinning anywhere, its moderate line variation keeps a long page of text feeling gentle and unhurried.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-halant: Nulshock stretches out in spacious, unshaded outlines, with arches on r, n and m that match their stems. Halant follows with curves that thicken gently at the shoulders, so extended reading feels traditional and settled.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-lisu-bosa: Stretched, technical and bold, Nulshock gives every stroke the same visual weight. And Lisu Bosa, with its spilling counters and big sturdy lowercase, carries a long passage with editorial ease, its weight shifts present but never dramatic.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab sets robust downstrokes against slender turns, with a sizable x-height and an open channel in the e. Beside Nulshock's one-nib outlines, that restrained thick-thin gap is the pair's clearest difference.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Nulshock's stretched, spacious capitals and hairline-free, swell-free outlines look technical and bold, nearly cable-like. Noto Serif Hentaigana is gentler, so give it a slightly larger size.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with authority, its thins barely lighter than its thicks. Under Nulshock's hairline-free outlines, its strokes narrow gradually toward the terminals, which keeps a long passage moving smoothly.
